stem: A banner test's relative lift fell from +6% to +2% over four weeks. The last two weeks were the run-up to Sinterklaas, when shoppers behave differently. A colleague says this proves a novelty effect. What is the best reply?

options.text: It proves novelty: every lift that fades over time is a novelty effect
It proves primacy, because the size of the effect changed during the test
It proves that the banner never worked, since its lift did not last
It may be novelty, but the season may also have changed the effect
